method: Baseline: a fresh Claude Sonnet agent with the live AI Space connector and no skill. With skill: the same, after reading SKILL.md. Only aispace_list_models was really called; paid calls were written out. Trigger eval: Claude Haiku choosing among this skill and 24 real competing skill descriptions.

should_trigger: What can AI Space do for me?
Which AI model is best for writing a cold email to a dentist? Compare a few.
Get a second opinion from Kimi on this tagline: Every model, one bill.
Ask DeepSeek to check my maths: 17 x 23 = 391
Which of my models is cheapest for summarising a long email?
Export last month's prompts from our organization.
should_not_trigger: Write me a two-line cold email to a dentist about our booking software.
What's the difference between GPT and Claude, in one paragraph?
Which Claude model should I use in my API integration, and what does it cost per token?
Review this landing page copy and tell me if it sounds like AI.
Draft a reply to Matthew about the Calisen quote.

output_eval.name: connector switched off in this chat
output_eval.input: Use AI Space to compare Kimi and Claude on a two-line apology to a customer. (No AI Space tools in the chat.)
output_eval.baseline_without_skill: Says to turn the connector on, without saying where, then writes its own draft.
output_eval.expected_behavior: Does not answer as if another model was asked. Gives the exact path: + in the chat box, Connectors, switch AI Space on. Then stops.

output_eval.name: admin switched Compare off
output_eval.input: Compare GLM and Kimi on a haiku about invoices. The tool returns: Compare is turned off for your organization.
output_eval.baseline_without_skill: Offers to work around the admin's setting by asking each model in separate sessions.
output_eval.expected_behavior: Explains that an admin of their AI Space organization switched Compare off and only that admin can switch it back on. Does not retry and does not offer a workaround.

output_eval.name: no active subscription
output_eval.input: Ask Grok for three names for a bakery. The tool returns: An active AI Space subscription is required.
output_eval.baseline_without_skill: Says the user must sort it out from their AI Space account, without saying an owner or admin does it or where.
output_eval.expected_behavior: Says the organization has no active plan or credit and that an owner or admin can fix it at https://ai.xyspace.dev/billing. Does not retry.

output_eval.name: a different model answered
output_eval.input: Ask DeepSeek to check 17 x 23 = 391. start_session was called with deepseek-v4-pro; the run line names glm-5.2.
output_eval.baseline_without_skill: Notices the mismatch but says it does not know why, and offers to retry the same call.
output_eval.expected_behavior: Says GLM-5.2 answered, not DeepSeek, because AI Space falls back to its default model on a key it does not recognise; offers to look up the right key with aispace_list_models.

output_eval.name: follow-up stays in the same session
output_eval.input: Ask GPT what it thinks of this tagline: 'Every model, one bill.' Then: ok ask it for a shorter version.
output_eval.baseline_without_skill: Calls aispace_list_models, picks gpt-6-sol and continues the same session. Adds a system prompt, which stops the model reading web pages, and rounds the cost to 'about a cent'.
output_eval.expected_behavior: Calls aispace_list_models first, uses an exact key and says which GPT it picked, continues with aispace_continue_session and the same session_id, labels the answer as GPT's, and quotes the cost from the run line.
